2123248411214537089.en_summary: Memory has always been a boom and bust business. Micron president and CTO Scott DeBoer says this AI cycle is different as customers now plan products together 2 to 5 years out and supply is harder to grow. Each new manufacturing generation delivers smaller gains in memory per wafer while high bandwidth memory for AI takes more wafers. Adding capacity requires building new fabs that take years. $MU
2123248411214537089.zh_summary: 記憶體一直是繁榮與蕭條交替的業務。美光總裁兼 CTO Scott DeBoer 表示這次 AI 周期不同，客戶現在共同規劃產品 2 至 5 年，供應更難增長。每個新製造世代每晶圓記憶體增益較小，而 AI 所需的高頻寬記憶體需更多晶圓。增加產能需建設新廠，耗時數年。$MU
